title: Rebrand author/owner fields to "Opum AI"
summary: User ruling via opum-agent: the brand string is 'Opum AI', tying to the opum.ai domain. Display/identity fields only, not identifiers: marketplace.json's owner.name and all three plugins[].author.name ('Opum' -> 'Opum AI'), and plugin.json's (opum-workflow) author.name. Explicitly NOT touched: marketplace.json's top-level name: 'opum' (functional identifier -- the marketplace slug and on-disk plugin cache path, ~/.claude/plugins/cache/opum/..., changing it would break plugin resolution fleet-wide), any plugin name field, and description prose ('Opum fleet plugins', 'Opum repositories') -- opum-agent is raising the prose split (Opum AI = company, Opum = product family) with the user separately rather than deciding it here; this task holds prose exactly as-is pending that. Checked scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs before landing per opum-agent's explicit ask: it validates only the version field against each pinned tag's own plugin.json, never author -- so this repo's author-field change has no landing-order dependency on lore-cli/quest-cli's own author updates.

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json: owner.name and all three plugins[].author.name changed from 'Opum' to 'Opum AI'. Nothing else in marketplace.json touched -- name, plugin names, descriptions, sources all byte-identical to before.
plugin.json (opum-workflow): author.name changed from 'Opum' to 'Opum AI'. Nothing else in plugin.json touched, including its own 'name' and 'version' fields.

Confirmed, not assumed, that the live federated pin checker (scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs) does not validate author fields -- so this change carries no ordering dependency on lore-cli/quest-cli's own author updates landing first, concurrently, or later.

implementationNotes: Diff reviewed line-by-line before committing: exactly 4 fields changed (marketplace.json's owner.name + 3x plugins[].author.name, plugin.json's author.name), everything else -- name/identifier fields, all prose -- byte-identical. Both files valid JSON, manifests check, live federated pin check (real network fetch), and 46/46 hook tests all clean afterward.
finalSummary: All four author/owner fields moved to 'Opum AI'. Identifiers and description prose untouched, per the ruling's own distinction. Confirmed live that the federated pin checker validates version only, so no coordination needed with lore-cli/quest-cli's own author updates.
